values.description:
Zero Trust Workload Identity Manager is Red Hat's Multi-cluster Workload Identity solution based on upstream SPIRE https://spiffe.io/docs/latest/spire, SPIRE is a toolchain of APIs for establishing trust between software systems across a wide variety of hosting platforms. SPIRE exposes the SPIFFE Workload API https://spiffe.io/docs/latest/spiffe-about/spiffe-concepts/#spiffe-workload-api which can attest running software systems and issue SPIFFE IDs https://spiffe.io/docs/latest/spiffe-about/spiffe-concepts/#spiffe-id
 and SVIDs https://spiffe.io/docs/latest/spiffe-about/spiffe-concepts/#spiffe-verifiable-identity-document-svid to them. SPIRE can work within both traditional VM infrastructures as well as Containers/platforms making it extensible beyond Cloud Native environments. This project will track the productization of SPIRE to be deployed on OpenShift and its integration with other layered products.
values.name: Zero Trust Workload Identity Manager
